text_block_list.text:
On the way back, as Satono Diamond and I 
passed through the shopping district—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle 
is underway~! The grand prize is an 
all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg 
Steak"! 2nd prize is "Mountain of 
Carrots"! 3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the 
fun, fun lottery! Anyone and everyone, 
come on over!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Wah, a prize raffle!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
That's... the kind of lottery wheel you 
spin with a rattle! A raffle just isn't 
the same without one!
choice_data_list: Do you have a particular preference?
Do you have a particular preference?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
With that type, you turn it by hand, so 
you can adjust your strength and turning 
speed, right?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
It feels wonderful knowing that seizing 
good fortune depends entirely on my own 
efforts!
choice_data_list: Wanna try the raffle?

text_block_list.text:
Remembering that I had received a lottery 
ticket while shopping, I asked about it.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'd love to!! I'll definitely draw the 
grand prize!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Aaaalieeen--!!

Satono Diamond cranked the lottery 
machine's lever with extraordinary 
determination!
And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!! The Grand 
Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been 
won~~~~!!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
W-We... We did it~~!! The grand prize! 
It's the grand prize, Trainer-san!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
See? See? Just like I told you! Good 
fortune is something you seize with sheer 
willpower!!
choice_data_list: Yeah, that's incredible...!
Yeah, that's amazing...!

text_block_list.text:
Pulling the grand prize just as she 
declared felt like a true victory of pure 
willpower.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, it looks like this year is going to 
be a wonderful one♪
choice_data_list: Go enjoy the hot springs with Kitasan.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm giving it to you, Trainer. The 
raffle ticket is yours, after all.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Just getting to draw in the lottery is 
enough to satisfy me!
choice_data_list: But you're the one who got it right, so...
But you're the one who got it right, so...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
In that case, Trainer, shall the two of us 
go together?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
How about a company retreat? Yes, that 
sounds great! It's settled!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Now that we've reached the milestone of 
our first three years in the Twinkle 
Series, let's celebrate each other's hard 
work! Milestones call for appreciation and 
celebration, after all!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Having a reward motivates you more, 
doesn't it?
choice_data_list: Yeah.
That's true.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Then it's settled! That's a promise!

To fight through the entire Senior Year 
with satisfying results. We promised to 
use this vacation ticket once that day 
came.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~! The 
prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Oh my, a carrot hamburg steak...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
The wild appearance is lovely, isn't it? 
Back at home, the carrots were always cut 
up, so enjoying them like this was a treat 
when eating out♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I can eat this whole whole carrot cleanly 
without knocking it over!
choice_data_list:
You didn't knock a single one over the 
whole way!?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes♪ First, on top of the carrot... It'll 
be faster if I just show you. Trainer, 
let's eat this together!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, allow me to show you... Dia's 
secret technique!

With graceful knife and fork work, Satono 
Diamond neatly eats her Salisbury steak 
without knocking over the carrot.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"...Thank you for the meal. It was truly 
top-grade, absolutely delicious!"
choice_data_list: That was an exquisite tea ceremony...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... I once heard an old jinx that bad 
luck lies in whichever direction the 
carrot on a carrot steak falls.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I figured that if I ate it 
without dropping anything, unlucky 
directions wouldn't even exist, so I 
mastered it.
choice_data_list: You were trying to break the jinx?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Everyone is always surprised, so it 
makes for a great conversation starter. 
Would you like to give it a try too, 
Trainer?

Afterward, Satono Diamond initiated me 
into her secret technique, and I learned 
how to eat without knocking over a single 
carrot!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!! The prize is a "Mountain 
of Carrots"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Waaah, I received so much♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, please take it home with you. 
The lottery tickets belong to you after 
all, Trainer."
choice_data_list: There's no way I can eat all this!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Oh my... in that case, shall we share some 
with everyone in the dorm?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"It feels a bit dull just as it is, so 
let's cook it up and bring it over as a 
treat♪"
choice_data_list: What are you going to make?
What are you going to make?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Actually, there's something I've been 
wanting to make... Carrot taiyaki!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
We'll fill the taiyaki with everyone's 
favorite, carrot bean paste. And add 
carrot râpées as an accent.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Let's knead carrots into the batter 
too... and mix in some carrot chips! It'll 
be a cute orange taiyaki♪"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"And then you stick a whole carrot right 
into it! Just like a carrot hamburger 
steak!!"
choice_data_list: T-That's certainly... novel...
T-That's certainly... novel...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Do you think so too, Trainer? If it turns 
out well, I'm planning to propose it as a 
new menu item for our group's restaurant 
division♪

Feeling a little uneasy at how novel it 
was, I offered to help with the cooking.

The next day—Satono Diamond reported that 
the "Carrot Taiyaki" were a huge hit with 
the Ritto dorm students.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: 3rd prize~! The prize is "one carrot"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Just one... I'm so sorry, Trainer. Even 
though that was such a valuable raffle 
ticket...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
It seems I lacked sufficient fighting 
spirit...
choice_data_list: Then let's eat that and cheer up!
Then eat that and cheer up!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? Are you sure it's alright for me 
to have this...?
choice_data_list: Please take it!
Please take it!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Giving me your only precious carrot... 
Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
The carrot you gave me, Trainer... My very 
own, one-of-a-kind carrot...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure it tastes like the best in the 
whole wide world♪

I'm glad Satono Diamond enjoyed it. 
—Though the shopkeeper was breaking out in 
a cold sweat under the pressure of serving 
"the world's best flavor."

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost! Your consolation prize 
is a pack of tissues~
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ......right.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I'm pulling one more time!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I won't accept a loss! I'll overturn this 
result, just you watch!!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: Um... do you have a raffle ticket?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: No. Where can I buy it!?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
They're not actually for sale~ You get 
them as a gift when you shop at the 
shopping street—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
So all I need to do is go shopping!? 
Understood, I am on my way!
choice_data_list: Wait! Let's calm down a bit, okay!?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Please do not stop me!! As an Umamusume of 
the Satono family, I cannot run away from 
this trial!

Just like breaking a jinx, it seems her 
competitive spirit against bad luck has 
been ignited. —Or maybe she's just being 
stubborn...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: As for my wallet...—Wait, huh!?

On this day, Satono Diamond apparently 
forgot her wallet in the dorms. Thanks to 
that, I managed to talk her out of pulling 
more gacha.
